title: Google’s AI is being manipulated. The search giant is quietly fighting back
summary: This BBC Future article explores how Google's AI systems are being targeted by manipulation attempts from SEO spam artists, content creators, and various actors trying to game AI-powered search results, and details Google's quiet countermeasures to detect and prevent such attacks on its AI Overviews and Gemini-powered features.
problem_solved: Addresses the growing challenge of adversarial manipulation attempts on AI-powered search results and the ongoing cat-and-mouse game between AI companies and those trying to exploit their systems.
why_valuable: Provides rare insight into the real-world security challenges facing deployed AI systems, highlighting the gap between lab performance and production reliability in AI search products.
